readings.title: The five-minute connection
readings.instruction: Read the original simulation passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: Northgate changed a bus timetable so that a local service arrived five minutes before an evening train. On paper the connection looked convenient. Passengers soon reported that the walk between the bus stop and platform took longer for anyone carrying bags or using the lift. The transport team timed the route with several users and moved the bus arrival earlier. The adjustment slightly increased waiting time for some passengers but made the connection usable by more people. A timetable represented more than vehicle movements: it also had to allow for the human journey between them.
knowledgePoints: 阅读：主旨、细节、推断与语境词义

options.D: The bus ticket could not be used on trains.

questions.explanation: 文中明确支持 The transfer walk took longer than the timetable allowed.；其余选项与所述措施、原因或事实不符。

readings.title: A map that began at the stop
readings.instruction: Read the original simulation passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A bus company displayed a large network map at every shelter. New passengers often struggled to locate their current position among dozens of routes. Designers added a small local panel with 'You are here', nearby landmarks and the directions in which buses left that stop. They kept the network map for longer journeys. Requests for basic directions became less frequent, though staff still checked whether the panels were readable after dark. The change showed that giving more information was not always the solution. Sometimes people first needed a clear starting point from which to interpret the information already available.

readings.title: When a delay repeats
readings.instruction: Read the original simulation passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A commuter complained that her bus was late 'all the time'. A travel adviser asked her to note the scheduled and actual arrival times for two weeks. The record showed a repeated delay on market mornings but little delay on other days. The bus company compared this with road conditions and changed the turning arrangement near the market. The evidence did not describe every service or season, but it made the complaint specific enough to investigate. The commuter still reported occasional problems, now with dates and times. A clear record helped separate a recurring issue from an isolated inconvenience.

readings.title: The last bus notice
readings.instruction: Read the original simulation passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A college printed the time of the last bus on its evening-class welcome sheet. Several students relied on it for months, even after the timetable changed. The college then replaced the fixed time with a link and telephone number for current information, while displaying a dated timetable near the exit. Tutors also announced major changes received from the operator. The new arrangement required regular attention, but reduced dependence on an undated sheet. Staff learnt that useful information could become misleading without being false when first printed. Responsibility included showing when it had last been checked.

translation.stem:
Translate the following original passage into Chinese. Preserve the meaning and logical relationships.

A useful transport system connects journeys as well as places. A short bus ride may become inconvenient if passengers face a long wait for the next service. Clear information cannot remove every delay, but it helps people make choices. Passengers also need reliable ways to report recurring problems.
translation.referenceAnswer: 实用的交通系统不仅连接地点，也衔接不同旅程。如果乘客换乘时要等很久，一段短途公交行程也可能变得不方便。清晰的信息无法消除所有延误，却能帮助人们作出选择。乘客还需要可靠的渠道来反映反复出现的问题。
translation.explanation: 参考译文仅示范一种表达。评分时关注信息完整性、转折和条件等逻辑关系；意思准确且中文自然的其他译法同样有效。

criteria.name: 意义完整与准确
criteria.description: 准确传达各句核心信息、对象和逻辑关系；按遗漏或误译程度酌情扣分。

criteria.name: 中文表达
criteria.description: 中文自然通顺，句间衔接合理；不拘泥于英语词序。

criteria.name: 细节与规范
criteria.description: 关键词译法贴合语境，指代清楚，标点和文字规范。

knowledgePoints: 英译汉：语义准确与逻辑衔接

writing.stem:
Write an English response of about 120 words to the following original simulation task. Use your own examples and organise your ideas clearly.

Write to a transport officer about improving bus connections for evening learners. Describe a difficulty and suggest a realistic improvement.
writing.sampleAnswer: Dear Transport Officer, I attend evening classes near Northgate Station. Our class ends shortly before the last connecting bus leaves, but the walk to the stop takes several minutes. Students who need the lift or carry heavy materials often miss the connection and face a long wait elsewhere. Please consider moving the bus departure a little later on teaching evenings. Before changing the timetable, staff could time the route with passengers who move at different speeds. Clear information at the college exit would also help us plan. I understand that a change may affect other connections, so a short trial with passenger feedback could be useful. Thank you for considering the needs of evening learners. Yours faithfully, A student
writing.explanation: 范文供完成作答后对照。允许不同立场与例子；围绕题目要求论述清楚、理由充分、语言准确即可。

criteria.name: 任务完成与内容
criteria.description: 回应题目所有要求，观点明确，包含相关理由、具体例子或可行建议。

criteria.name: 组织与衔接
criteria.description: 结构清楚，信息顺序合理，句段衔接自然，格式符合写作目的。

criteria.name: 语言与表达
criteria.description: 词汇使用恰当，句式基本准确，表达清晰；错误按其对理解的影响扣分。

knowledgePoints: 英语写作：观点、建议与应用文
